Toy list of SingleCellExperiment objects

Source: R/count_matrices.R
count_matrices.Rd

A simulated dataset generated using zinb_simdata() for demonstrating functions in the scGraphVerse package.

Usage

data(count_matrices)

Format

A list with 3 SingleCellExperiment objects, each of dimension 35 genes x 40 cells.

Examples

data(count_matrices)
str(count_matrices)
